name: Bun mam nem
summary: Bún mắm nêm is a separate name from bún mắm on the Da Nang pages. The 18 May 2020 page lists it for a longer stay. The 12 Jun 2026 markets page names it at Con Market. Neither page describes the bowl.
origin: Named in Da Nang, beside bún mắm, not in place of it. A broth was not printed.
howToEat: The city pages name bún mắm nêm and do not describe a method. Check on arrival.

where: Con Market, on the 12 Jun 2026 markets page, with mì Quảng, bánh bèo, bánh nậm, bánh xèo, and nem lụi. The 18 May 2020 page lists it and does not name a door.
